level.title: Advanced: conditionals, politeness, debate, culture
goals: Use 如果…就 and plans naturally
Speak politely and debate with connectors
Discuss Chinese culture with real fluency

lessons.title: 如果…就
lessons.learn: The IF-frame! 如果下雨，我就不去 (if it rains, I won't go). 即使…也 (even if): 即使下雨，我也去! 虽然…但是 (although): 虽然贵，但是好! 只要 (as long as), 只有 (only if)!

grammar.title: 如果…就 · 即使…也 · 虽然…但是
grammar.explain: 如果下雨，我就不去 (if rains, won't go). 即使下雨，我也去 (even if rains, go)! 虽然贵，但是好 (although expensive, good)!
grammar.pattern: 如果…就 · 即使…也 · 虽然…但是

examples.r: rú guǒ xià yǔ, wǒ jiù bú qù.
examples.en: If it rains, I won't go.

examples.r: jí shǐ xià yǔ, wǒ yě qù!
examples.en: Even if it rains, I'll go!

examples.r: suī rán guì, dàn shì hǎo.

mistakes: Saying 如果…但是 — 如果 pairs with 就!
Forgetting 也: 即使…也 needs 也!

dialogue.t: 如果明天下雨，你怎么办?
dialogue.r: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ, nǐ zěn me bàn?
dialogue.en: If it rains tomorrow, what will you do?

dialogue.r: jí shǐ xià yǔ, wǒ yě qù!
dialogue.en: Even if it rains, I'll go!

dialogue.r: zhǐ yào xué xí, jiù huì dǒng!
dialogue.en: As long as you study, you'll understand!

dialogue.r: wǒ huì nǔ lì!

practice.q: Say: If it rains, I won't go
Order: 我就不去 / 下雨 / 如果
Say aloud: 如果下雨，我就不去。

items: If it rains, I won't go
Even if it rains, I'll go
If it rains tomorrow, what will you do?
key: 如果明天下雨，你怎么办

lessons.title: Let's and plans: 吧/打算
lessons.learn: Suggest with 吧! 我们去吧 (let's go!), 吃吧! Plans: 打算 (plan to): 我打算去中国. Decided: 决定了: 我决定去了! 安排 = arranged. Rally everyone!

grammar.title: 吧 + 打算/决定了
grammar.explain: 我们一起去吧! (let's go together!). 我打算去中国 (I plan to go to China). 我决定去了 (I decided to go)!
grammar.pattern: verb + 吧 · 打算 · 决定了

examples.r: wǒ men yì qǐ chī ba!
wǒ dǎ suan qù Zhōng guó.
examples.en: I plan to go to China.

mistakes: Saying 吧 for orders to elders — 吧 is for peers-offers!
Saying 打算了 for decided — decided: 决定了!

dialogue.r: míng tiān zuò shén me?
wǒ jué dìng qù Běi jīng le!
dialogue.en: I decided to go to Beijing!

dialogue.r: hǎo! wǒ men yì qǐ qù ba!
yí dìng!

practice.q: Order: 吃吧 / 一起 / 我们
Say aloud: 我们一起吃吧!

items: I plan to go to China

lessons.title: Politeness: 请/麻烦/您
lessons.learn: Polite power! 请 (please), 麻烦你 (trouble-you = please…): 麻烦你开门! 不好意思 (excuse me), 劳驾 (excuse me, passing). 您 = honored you. 贵姓? = Your honorable surname?

grammar.title: 麻烦你… + 您/贵
grammar.explain: 麻烦你开门 (trouble-you open the door = please open it). 您好 (honored hello). 贵姓? → 免贵姓王 (no-honor, surname Wang — humble reply)!
grammar.pattern: 麻烦你 + verb · 您/贵 honorifics
mistakes: Saying 你 to honored elders — use 您!
Answering 贵姓 with 我贵姓王 — humble: 免贵姓王!

dialogue.r: nín hǎo! guì xìng?
miǎn guì xìng Wáng. nín ne?
dialogue.en: My surname is Wang. And yours?

dialogue.r: miǎn guì xìng Lǐ. má fan nǐ kāi mén!
dialogue.en: My surname is Li. Please open the door!

dialogue.r: hǎo de!

practice.q: Say: Please open the door (trouble you)

quiz.q: 您 vs 你: the difference is…

lessons.title: Debate connectors
lessons.learn: Argue in Chinese! 但是 (but), 所以 (so), 也就是说 (in other words), 比如 (for example), 而且 (moreover), 总之 (in short), 结果 (in the end). Chain: 比如…而且…所以…!

grammar.title: Connector chains
grammar.explain: 地铁很方便。但是很挤。也就是说，很好! (The subway is handy. But crowded. In short, good!). Start sentences with 但是/所以/比如!

examples.r: dì tiě hěn fāng biàn. dàn shì hěn jǐ.
examples.en: The subway is handy. But it's crowded.

examples.r: bǐ rú, Běi jīng hěn dà.
yě jiù shì shuō, dì tiě hěn hǎo!
examples.en: In short, the subway is good!

mistakes: Ending sentences with 但是 — 但是 starts sentences!
Stacking 但是…但是 — vary with 而且/也就是说!

dialogue.r: dì tiě hěn fāng biàn. dàn shì hěn jǐ.
dialogue.en: The subway is handy. But it's crowded.

dialogue.r: dàn shì qì chē hěn kuài!
ér qiě dì tiě hěn pián yi!
yě jiù shì shuō, dì tiě hěn hǎo!
dialogue.en: In short, the subway is good!

practice.q: Say: In short, the subway is good!
Order: 地铁很好 / 也就是说
Say aloud: 也就是说，地铁很好!

items: The subway is handy. But it's crowded
In short, the subway is good
In short, the subway is good!

lessons.title: Chinese culture: food and festivals
lessons.learn: Culture time! 饺子 (dumplings), 月饼 (mooncakes), 春节 (Spring Festival), 中秋节 (Mid-Autumn). Celebrate: 过年 (celebrate New Year)! 成语 (idioms): 画龙点睛 (add the finishing touch)!

grammar.title: 过 (celebrate) + 成语 teaser
grammar.explain: 过年 (celebrate New Year), 过生日 (celebrate birthday)! 成语 = 4-character wisdom: 马马虎虎 (so-so — horse-horse-tiger-tiger)!

examples.r: wǒ men guò nián chī jiǎo zi.
examples.en: At New Year we eat dumplings.

examples.r: Zhōng qiū jié chī yuè bǐng.

mistakes: Saying 玩年 for New Year — celebrate: 过年!
Translating 成语 literally — learn the STORY!

dialogue.r: nǐ chī guo jiǎo zi ma?
chī guo! hěn hǎo chī!
Zhōng qiū jié chī yuè bǐng!
wǒ zuì xǐ huan yuè bǐng!

practice.q: 'At New Year we eat dumplings' is…
Order: 饺子吗 / 吃过 / 你
Say aloud: 你吃过饺子吗?

items: At New Year we eat dumplings

lessons.title: Storytelling: 从前
lessons.learn: Graduation! 从前 (long ago), 有一天 (one day), 突然 (suddenly), 终于 (finally/at last), 最后 (in the end). Mix helpers: 去了, 吃过, 会去! Tell YOUR Beijing story!

grammar.title: Story spine: 从前…最后
grammar.explain: 从前…有一天…突然…终于…最后 — the five-beat Chinese story spine. Mix 了/过/会: 去了北京，吃过烤鸭，会再去!
grammar.pattern: 从前 → 有一天 → 突然 → 最后

examples.r: cóng qián wǒ qù le Běi jīng.
examples.en: Long ago, I went to Beijing.

examples.r: zuì hòu wǒ huí jiā le.

mistakes: Starting tales with 昨天 — stories open 从前!
Using only 了 — mix 过 + 会 + 把!

dialogue.r: cóng qián wǒ qù le Běi jīng.
dialogue.en: Long ago, I went to Beijing.

dialogue.r: lì hai! rán hòu ne?
tū rán xià xuě le!
zuì hòu ne?
zuì hòu wǒ gāo xìng de huí jiā le!

practice.q: Say: Long ago, I went to Beijing
Say aloud: 从前我去了北京。
